claim_limit: estimates apply only to the frozen model and designed parameter space; no historical prevalence, legality, or unmodeled field causation

u2o_progression_failure_partition.claim_boundary: exclusive reporting decomposition of the frozen fail-open policy; not distinct policy effects

u3_evidence_stage_accounting.claim_boundary: sequential stage accounting for a bundled policy; not independent component effects

extension_rule: if any applicable primary metric exceeds its target after 30 replications, extend every policy in every valid family to 60 replications using the next frozen seeds

process_contrasts.claim_boundary: event counts per initiated case; not effort, welfare, cost, or overall policy value
